## 1. Primary System Overview
The MMS Triadic Core Engine v2 introduces a zero-throttling, scale-invariant processing architecture engineered natively for deployment on vertically stacked monolayer Molybdenum Disulfide (MoS2) semiconductor substrates [1.14]. The system architecture operates strictly as a Massless Resonant Standing-Wave Cavity, organizing internal energy layers via a Quantized Fourier Harmonic Series to completely eliminate the continuous field-effect gate approximations, calculation chatter, and rounding drift of conventional silicon design [1.14].

- Register Word Size: 54-Bit Dedicated Whole-Integer Scaled Hardware Word Floor [1.14]
